title: ビジネスプロセス分析
subtitle: Analysis of Business Processes
educationalGoal: This course aims to provide students with the skills needed to improve business processes. Students will learn: (1) how to visualize processes. (2) how to evaluate processes using time and cost. (3) how to demonstrate improvement with figures and diagrams.
advice: This is a basic course in improving the operations of business processes. We will cover the following topics: 1) Process visualization with data-flow diagrams. 2) Evaluating processes using time and cost. 3) Calculating the expected effect of the improvement.

activityGoals.body: Be able to effectively explain business processes.
Be able to clearly explain the process model.
Be able to describe specific processes in a data-flow diagram.
Be able to describe an improved process in a data-flow diagram.
Be able to calculate and explain the expected effect of the improvement.
